risks.title: Dependence on JV AVAIL Results
risks.score_rationale: The $317.3M net income in 2026 is primarily driven by $204.5M in asset sale gains from JV AVAIL. A future decline in JV revenues would directly impact overall profitability, as noted in operational results. The language highlights a critical dependence on this non-recurring source.

risks.title: Competitive Pricing Pressures
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions competitive pressures affecting selling prices in the Metal Coatings and Precoat Metals segments. These pressures are recurring and specific to market dynamics, indicating a moderate to high structural risk.

risks.title: Sector Demand Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Demand is tied to construction, industrial, and transportation markets, whose variations are noted as directly impacting volumes (e.g., a 2.3% decline in Precoat Metals). The risk is reiterated in business analysis and outlook.

risks.title: Raw Material Cost Risks
risks.score_rationale: Increased zinc, labor, and overhead costs are cited as factors driving up cost of sales by $66.8M. While not explicitly labeled a risk, the actual impact on gross margin is significant.

risks.title: Limited Liquidity Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Available cash is limited despite substantial credit capacity. This limited immediate liquidity reserve could pose challenges in the event of an unexpected shock, although credit availability mitigates the risk.

risks.title: Legal and Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The Infrastructure Solutions segment recorded $6.5M in litigation-related charges in 2025 and $1.2M in 2026. These recurring amounts indicate ongoing exposure to legal risks, though lower than previously.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration and Performance
risks.score_rationale: A $30.1M acquisition in Canton, Ohio, is mentioned. While not explicitly presented as a risk, integrating industrial assets carries operational and financial risks, especially within the context of recent restructuring.
